# Map: st-stm32-usart-v2 → uart 1.0.0

Compatible: st,stm32-usart, st,stm32-uart  
Manual: RM0433 Rev 8 section 48 (USART/UART), STM32H742/743/753/750  
Features: base, dma, fifo, inversion
